_note: Which database records make one route page. A route can be mapped as several records (stages, branches, an older and a newer mapping); listing them here under one slug merges them into one page. 'review' marks a grouping that is a guess and needs a person's yes. Tier: 1 = known by name, built with full care; 2 = national and regional; 3 = local.
